inclusions.source: Cairo receives three nights and two complete days: one for Giza and the Grand Egyptian Museum, the other for the Egyptian Museum on Tahrir and the older Christian quarter of the city.

inclusions.text: Three nights aboard a five-star Dahabiya
inclusions.source: The group then boards the five-star Dahabiya, home for the next three nights.

inclusions.text: Five-star all-inclusive beachfront resort on the Red Sea
inclusions.source: The change is immediate: the agricultural strip falls away, the mountains close around the road, and the journey ends at a five-star all-inclusive beachfront resort on the Red Sea.

This is a group journey: a scheduled departure travelling together as one party, with a shared, licensed Egyptologist guide and private air-conditioned transport throughout, plus domestic flights, entrances, and airport assistance from arrival to departure.

inclusions.text: Grand Egyptian Museum, Abu Simbel, Giftun Islands boat, snorkelling, diving, wind and kite activities, submarine journey, desert safari
inclusions.source: The Grand Egyptian Museum, Abu Simbel, the Dahabiya, the Giftun Islands boat, snorkelling, diving, wind and kite activities, the submarine journey, and the desert safari are all part of the route.

inclusions.text: Arrival meet and transfer to hotel
inclusions.source: The group is met at Cairo International Airport, assisted through arrival formalities, and transferred directly to the hotel.

inclusions.text: Day 1 dinner depending on arrival time
inclusions.source: Dinner is included or not depending on the arrival time.

inclusions.text: Valley of the Kings entrance (standard open royal tombs)
inclusions.source: The Valley of the Kings holds more than sixty known tombs cut into the limestone; the included entrance covers the standard open royal tombs, with additional access arranged for Tutankhamun and one of the valley's larger decorated tombs when open.

inclusions.text: Swimming, guided snorkelling, supervised introductory dive
inclusions.source: The programme includes swimming, guided snorkelling over the coral gardens, and a supervised introductory dive for first-time divers; certified divers can be matched with an appropriate guided dive instead.
The afternoon allows time for the coast's wind sports — windsurfing and kitesurfing sessions, included and adapted to experience, confidence, and weather.
